entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Just get me a person. Now.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return this VeloBand Pulse monitor. I want my money back, and I don't want a runaround.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
The name is Sam Jones. Order number is VF-8675309. You'd better find it.

Thank you, Sam. I'm pulling up your order now... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered 32 days ago. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's not broken, I just **changed my mind**, alright? It was a total **impulse buy** and I just **don't use it**. I want to return it. End of story.
Okay, thank you for clarifying that for me. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.

You'd better check it and it had better say 'yes'! If you people try to deny this, I will be your worst nightmare on every review site on the internet! I want to speak to a manager if this takes more than ten seconds!

That won't be necessary, Sam. I've just reviewed our policy, and I can see here that you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that return for a full refund for you right now.
Wait, what? Seriously? Just like that? No fight?
No fight at all. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending the pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on your account. You should receive it in the next few minutes.
Huh. Okay. Well... good. That's how it should be. Thank you.

You're very welcome. Once we receive the device back at our warehouse, your refund will be credited to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
No, that's it. Just make sure that email shows up.
It has already been sent. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
